newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Dukat silver mine may be tendered - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Dukat silver mine may be tendered - agency.

text.p: A senior regional Russian official has proposed tendering the state-owned Dukat silver mine, Russia's largest, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.
It quoted Viktor Mikhailov, head of the Magadan regional administration in Russia's Far East, as saying he had proposed holding an international tender in the next two to three weeks.
The State Property Committee and Property Fund, as well as various metals officials, must approve any sale of Dukat, which may contain about two-thirds of Russia's total silver reserves.
Magadan has seen a steep fall in silver output to 36 tonnes a year, far below the 400 tonnes Mikhailov said was possible.
Interfax said the Dukat mine-enriching complex, in northeastern Magadan, needs $150 million in investments, mostly from foreign investors, to overcome a severe financial crisis and to modernise.
